summary: Slides one at a time, moved by swiping, dragging, the arrow keys, the buttons or the dots; slides snap into place.

props.name: children
props.description: The slides, one per child, such as pictures or cards.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Names the carousel for screen readers.

props.name: loop
props.description: Wraps from the last slide back to the first.

props.name: aspectRatio
props.description: Each slide's width over its height, such as `16 / 10`.

props.name: dots
props.description: Draws the dots under the slides.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius of the slides and buttons. Inherits the nearest `Shape`.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. `merge` folds them in last, so one here replaces the component's own class for the same utility.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline. `true` draws it, `false` removes it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it on every focusable part of the component, which is more than `className` reaches. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.
